stemMd:
At first, the two studies seemed to contradict each other. Once their different age groups were considered, however, the results proved ______: each described a different stage of the same developmental pattern.

Which choice best completes the text?
explanationMd: The findings can coexist within one developmental account. Compatible expresses consistency without implying that the studies measured identical stages or can replace one another.

distractorRationale.d: The age distinction explains the results rather than showing them false.
distractorRationale.b: The text does not say the findings lack importance.
distractorRationale.c: Different stages can fit together without being identical or substitutable.
